The time when unit became active or started is printed after the "@" character.
The time the unit took to start is printed after the "+" character.

multi-user.target @3.180s
└─systemd-logind.service @2.850s +330ms
  └─basic.target @2.800s
    └─systemd-networkd.service @2.450s +350ms
      └─systemd-udevd.service @2.100s +350ms
        └─sysinit.target @2.050s
          └─systemd-journald.service @1.750s +300ms
            └─local-fs.target @1.700s
              └─systemd-fsck-root.service @1.450s +250ms
